name: Sheng Ge De Jia de Wan Zhong
source:
Knell of St. Godhrkar is Crime, Action and Dark Fantasy Thriller Visual Novel where every seemingly small choice made by a character may have fatal consequence for other playable characters.

Synopsis:
It is certainly looking to be a restless winter on December, Epi.1544. A homicide involving a priest just pushed the Church to the center of a vicious storm, arousing the attention of Ili City Police. In the shadows of darkness, different characters who share a common link, a mysterious telegram, come to light: The detective who is chasing this case, messengers of the Supreme Truth Learned Society, a student of Ili Medical University, an unidentified traveler from abroad, a confessor who no longer believes in the Church, and even a singer and hunter...
translation:
《圣戈德卡的丧钟》是一部犯罪、动作和黑暗奇幻惊悚视觉小说，角色做出的每一个看似微小的选择都可能对其他可玩角色产生致命的后果。

简介：
Epi.1544 12月肯定会是一个不安宁的冬天。一场涉及神父的凶杀案刚刚将教会推向了一场恶性风暴的中心，引起了伊犁市警方的关注。黑暗的阴影中，有着共同纽带的不同人物——一封神秘的电报浮出水面：追查此案的侦探、无上真理学会的使者、伊犁医科大学的学生、来自国外的身份不明的旅行者、不再信仰教会的忏悔神父、甚至是歌手兼猎人……
